question: The amount on a sum of ₹1,500 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use CI formula: A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

= 1500 × (1.1)²

= 1500 × 1.21

= 1815

**∴ Answer = ₹1815**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 1500, Rate = 10%, Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ A = 1500(1 + 10/100)²

⇒ = 1500(1.1)²

⇒ = 1500 × 1.21

⇒ = 1815

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1815.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Annual Compounding

Interest is added to principal after each year

Growth Factor

(1 + r/100) is called growth multiplier

Quick Tip

For 2 years: A = P(1 + r/100)²

12
